therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: monoclonal antibody neutralization / sequestration of soluble amyloid beta
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: amyloid plaque clearance / reduction of amyloid burden in the brain
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: cognitively normal older individuals at risk for memory loss (preclinical Alzheimer's disease)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline of the Preclinical Alzheimer Cognitive Composite (PACC) score at approximately Week 240

results.target_engagement_evidence: CSF Aβ 1-40 and Aβ 1-42 concentrations increased significantly in the solanezumab arm vs placebo (p<0.001), consistent with antibody-mediated sequestration of soluble amyloid beta
biomarker_changes: CSF Aβ 1-40: LS Mean change solanezumab +12151.4 ng/L vs placebo -587.1 ng/L; LS Mean difference +12738.4 (95% CI: 10757.0–14719.9), p<0.001
CSF Aβ 1-42: LS Mean change solanezumab +1045.6 ng/L vs placebo +49.2 ng/L; LS Mean difference +996.4 (95% CI: 875.9–1116.9), p<0.001
Flortaucipir SUVr (tau PET): LS Mean change solanezumab +0.066 vs placebo +0.108; LS Mean difference -0.042 (95% CI: -0.057 to -0.028), p<0.001
CSF total tau: LS Mean change solanezumab -17.2 ng/L vs placebo -20.4 ng/L; LS Mean difference +3.2 (95% CI: -62.0–68.5), p=0.922
CSF phosphorylated tau: LS Mean change solanezumab +10.3 ng/L vs placebo +11.2 ng/L; LS Mean difference -1.0 (95% CI: -6.2–4.3), p=0.717
Total hippocampal volume: LS Mean change solanezumab -0.369 cm³ vs placebo -0.314 cm³; LS Mean difference -0.054 (95% CI: -0.131–0.022), p=0.161
Total lateral ventricular volume: LS Mean change solanezumab +9.329 cm³ vs placebo +8.978 cm³; LS Mean difference +0.351 (95% CI: -0.535–1.236), p=0.437
safety_signals: Serious adverse events were generally balanced between solanezumab and placebo arms
Atrial fibrillation: 9/572 solanezumab vs 9/591 placebo in double-blind period
Acute myocardial infarction: 3/572 solanezumab vs 4/591 placebo in double-blind period
Angina unstable: 2/572 solanezumab vs 0 placebo in double-blind period

context.duration: Double-blind period approximately 240 weeks; extended to Week 336
